📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By TOM COLLOMOSSE, FOOTBALL REPORTER.

Published: 12:24 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 18:09 EST, 23 November 2026.

A lion has been spotted about ten miles from the stadium where Aston Villa are due to face Galatasaray in the Champions League on Tuesday.

In a bizarre development, Turkish security and wildlife personnel were on Monday searching for the animal​, believed to be roaming loose ‌in woodland north of Istanbul.

Around 70 people, including police and other emergency personnel, have been involved in the search, with seven drones deployed. The animal was first sighted in Istanbul's Sariyer district, which is also where Galatasaray's RAMS Park is located.

According to local reports, personnel at a police station in ​the Zekeriyakoy area, north of the ​European side of Istanbul, reported seeing 'an animal ⁠resembling a lion' on surveillance cameras at ​around 9pm local time on Sunday (6pm GMT).

Extensive security measures have been put in place around the forested area where the animal is believed to be located and nearby villas. Access to and from the area is being controlled, while residents have been warned to remain cautious.

'The area where the lion is located has been identified, and every effort is being made to capture it alive,' the Istanbul Governor's Office mentioned in a statement.

A lion has been spotted 10 miles from where Aston Villa are set to play in the Champions League on Tuesday.

The Istanbul Governor's Office remarked 'every effort' is being made to capture the lion alive.

According to recent reports, reaction to the lion's escape bordered on the surreal, with one outlet interviewing a person in a lion suit, wearing a Galatasaray shirt, about it. Galatasaray are nicknamed the Lions while Villa have a lion on their badge.

Sources indicate that gala defender Abdulkerim Bardakci was even asked about the matter, and replied: 'I want to say something because the whole country is talking about this right now. There's only one lion I keep at home, and that's my son.'.

Daily Mail Sport has contacted UEFA for an patch.

There were even suggestions in Turkey that Villa had cancelled their training session at RAMS Park because of the lion, but Villa did their preparation at Bodymoor Heath for a very different reason – the state of the RAMS Park pitch.

European football chiefs are confident the playing surface will pose no risk to Aston Villa after conducting thorough inspections.

The Turkish giants have commissioned intensive work on the pitch and moved their most recent league game, against Samsunspor, to the stadium of rivals Istanbul Basaksehir.

It has been revealed that yet it is thought conditions will be some way from perfect and though Villa boss Unai Emery played it down, he will be anxious about injuries. 'We have to think that if there was a risk of injury, we wouldn't be playing on it,' he noted. 'The pitch will be better or worse, for both teams.'.

Villa defender Ian Maatsen said: 'We don't know anything about the pitch. They say it's in a little bit of a bad condition but that's no excuse. We have to see how the pitch is. We are ready.'.

Galatasaray coach Okan Buruk added: 'It was dug up again, another hybrid treatment was applied, and seeds were planted. There is also sand mixed into the pitch to help.'.

Villa, who have been followed abroad by Prince William this season, will take on Galatasaray.

Aston Villa shocked Europe by marching straight into the last 16 in the Champions League two seasons ago but a win over Galatasaray will put them on course to repeat it.

Unai Emery’s side have nine points from a possible 12 in the league phase and victory in Istanbul will give them one foot in the knockout rounds.

Daily Mail Sport looks at what Villa can expect from one of the toughest tests on the European calendar.

European football chiefs are confident Galatasaray’s pitch will pose no risk to Aston Villa after conducting thorough inspections of the playing surface at RAMS Park.

The Turkish giants have commissioned intensive work on the pitch and moved their most recent league game, against Samsunspor, to the stadium of rivals Istanbul Basaksehir.

Yet it is thought conditions will be some way from perfect and though Villa boss Unai Emery played it down, he will be anxious about injuries.

According to recent reports, villa defender Ian Maatsen mentioned: ‘We don't know anything about the pitch. They say it's in a little bit of a bad condition but that's no excuse. We have to see how the pitch is. We are ready.’.

Galatasaray coach Okan Buruk added: ‘It was dug up again, another hybrid treatment was applied, and seeds were planted. There is also sand mixed into the pitch to help.’.

Villa are back in their happy place. This city hosted their 3-0 win over Freiburg in the Europa League Final last May, though that game happened at Tupras Stadium, home of Besiktas.

Repeat that result here and Villa will be eyeing a top-eight finish – which they also achieved two years ago. That would allow them to skip the play-off round early next year and head straight into the last 16.

European football chiefs are confident Galatasaray’s pitch will pose no risk to Aston Villa (Source: X/Forza Cimbom).

Will Garnacho’s chance ever come?

Five months into his loan spell from Chelsea, Alejandro Garnacho is still waiting for his first competitive start for Aston Villa.

When the Argentine moved to Villa Park, it was suggested that turning the temporary move into a £43million permanent deal would be a relative formality. Right now, that feels nearly impossible. Garnacho has featured for only 95 minutes this term and if Emery really did want the 22-year-old last summer, he has a funny way of showing it.

Indeed, Daily Mail Sport understands that even during Garnacho’s early days at the club, some Villa players were starting to wonder whether he would ever play regularly for Emery.

In a recent development, what next? There is believed to be no recall clause in the loan deal with Chelsea yet as Garnacho has only represented Villa this term, the clubs could agree to cancel the arrangement in January.

Sources indicate that born in Madrid, Garnacho was part of the youth system at Atletico before joining Manchester United. With four Argentines in the Atletico squad, plus another in boss Diego Simeone, that might be worth keeping an eye on.

Yet it is thought that neither Galatasaray nor Fenerbahce, who were monitoring Garnacho last summer, are in the market for a high-wage signing in January. That would close off one potential escape route.

Thanks to the sales of Morgan Rogers, Ezri Konsa and Youri Tielemans that brought in nearly £200million, Villa were able to spend heavily in the summer.

Recent findings suggest that to invest again in the winter, they will probably need to attract offers for some fringe players. As well as Garnacho, Tammy Abraham and Lamare Bogarde have been overlooked by Emery recently. Abraham has fallen behind Brian Madjo in the pecking order, though the 17-year-old was not included in the Champions League squad, while Bogarde’s only starts have been in the Carabao Cup, which is always low on Emery’s priority list. Selling Bogarde would also deliver pure profit – crucial for a club forever fighting to stay in line with Premier League and UEFA spending rules.

There were always going to be bumps in the road this season for Villa, and there will likely be more. In last Saturday’s dispiriting 0-0 draw with Sunderland, there were only two players – Emi Buendia and Pau Torres – in the starting XI who were also in the line-up for the Europa League Final. Replacing the six who departed will take time.

In their commendable attempts to bring down the average age of the squad, Villa find themselves with a surplus of attackers but no midfield controller since the departure of Tielemans, and they also look vulnerable in central defence.

In a recent development, tyrone Mings turns 34 in March and Victor Lindelof was 32 in July while Taylor Harwood-Bellis must find his feet rapidly in one of the most demanding competitions in the world. It is tough without Konsa.

According to recent reports, elsewhere, there are possibly too many options. George Hemmings and then Alysson have forced their way into the side at different times this season, meaning fewer opportunities for Ibrahim Mbaye, who cost nearly £50million from Paris Saint-Germain last summer. Johan Manzambi has played regularly and with John McGinn and Buendia also in the mix, a player like Garnacho has a near-impossible task to convince Emery.

Alejandro Garnacho is still waiting for his first competitive start for Aston Villa - five months after joining from Chelsea.

Scouts from across Europe have been watching Galatasaray’s matches this season and Aleksey Batrakov is usually the reason why.

The 21-year-old Russian playmaker has six goals – including four in the Champions League – and four assists since his £21million move from Lokomotiv Moscow and is one of the breakout stars of the world game.

He caught the eye of Paris Saint-Germain while playing for Lokomotiv and Barcelona boss Hansi Flick has praised him.

The last Russian to play in the Premier League was Pavel Pogrebnyak, whose last game for Reading was against West Ham in May 2013.

Given the current geopolitical situation, Pogrebnyak will surely hold that record for some time to come.

Serie A, schedine del turno: pronostici e comparazione quote

💡 Key Takeaways
  • La Serie A torna in campo per la 13ª giornata, in programma da venerdì 27 a lunedì 30 novembre.
  • Un programma ricco di partite da analizzare anche in ottica scommesse: dagli esiti finali ai mercati legati ai gol, sono diverse le possibilità per comporre una multipla.
  • In a recent development, la prima schedina propone una combinazione che alterna una giocata più lineare a tre esiti dal profilo maggiormente rischioso.

La Serie A torna in campo per la 13ª giornata, in programma da venerdì 27 a lunedì 30 novembre. Il turno si apre con Venezia-Bologna e prosegue sabato con l’Inter di Chivu, che ospita il Genoa a San Siro. Tra le sfide del fine settimana anche Torino-Lazio e Como-Juventus, mentre il Napoli sarà impegnato sul campo del Sassuolo.

Un programma ricco di partite da analizzare anche in ottica scommesse: dagli esiti finali ai mercati legati ai gol, sono diverse le possibilità per comporre una multipla. Ecco la nostra schedina della 13ª giornata di Serie A, con una selezione di pronostici e quote per il weekend di campionato.

In a recent development, la prima schedina propone una combinazione che alterna una giocata più lineare a tre esiti dal profilo maggiormente rischioso. Si parte da Venezia-Bologna, con il segno 1 quotato 3.16 da PokerStars, 3.10 da Snai e 3.15 da BetFlag, mentre in Torino-Lazio la scelta ricade sul pareggio, proposto a 3.31 da PokerStars, 3.25 da Snai e 3.30 da BetFlag. Anche in Udinese-Fiorentina viene preso in considerazione il segno X, con quote di 3.40 da PokerStars e Snai e 3.45 da BetFlag. Chiude la combinazione il successo esterno del Napoli in Sassuolo-Napoli, esito indicato a 1.66 da PokerStars, 1.65 da Snai e 1.65 da BetFlag. Una schedina che abbina quindi una selezione più coperta, come il 2 del Napoli, a risultati più complessi che contribuiscono ad alzare il valore complessivo della multipla. Nel complesso si tratta di una proposta costruita su un equilibrio particolare: da una parte un favorito abbastanza chiaro come il Napoli, dall’altra due pareggi e una vittoria interna tutt’altro che scontata. Proprio i segni X di Torino-Lazio e Udinese-Fiorentina rappresentano le giocate che possono incidere maggiormente sulla resa finale della schedina, mentre Venezia-Bologna aggiunge un ulteriore elemento di difficoltà. È una combinazione che punta quindi su una lettura meno banale del turno, con un potenziale rendimento più alto ma anche con un livello di rischio inevitabilmente superiore.

La seconda schedina si apre con il segno 1 in Roma-Monza, esito considerato il più probabile dagli operatori e quotato 1.19 da PokerStars e Snai e 1.20 da BetFlag. In Como-Juventus la scelta resta ancora sul successo interno, con il segno 1 offerto a 1.97 da PokerStars, 1.95 da Snai e 2.00 da BetFlag. A seguire troviamo il pareggio in Lecce-Atalanta, proposto a 3.75 da PokerStars e Snai e 3.80 da BetFlag, mentre in Cagliari-Milan la giocata selezionata è il successo dei sardi, quotato 4.60 da PokerStars, 4.50 da Snai e 4.85 da BetFlag. Una combinazione che alterna due esiti più prudenti a due risultati dal coefficiente sensibilmente più elevato. La struttura della seconda multipla appare quindi più aggressiva nella parte finale, dove il pareggio tra Lecce e Atalanta e soprattutto il segno 1 di Cagliari-Milan alzano in modo netto il valore della schedina. Roma-Monza rappresenta la base più solida della combinazione, mentre Como-Juventus aggiunge un livello intermedio di rischio. È una schedina pensata per chi cerca una soluzione meno conservativa, nella quale i due esiti ad alta quota diventano il vero elemento distintivo dell’intera proposta.

Arsenal will host old nemesis José Mourinho’s Real Madrid in the league phase of the Champions League.

Mourinho, the former Chelsea, Manchester United and Tottenham Hotspur manager, will return to London to resume hostilities against last season’s beaten finalists.

Other reunions from Thursday’s draw include Manchester City travelling to Barcelona, to whom they last week sold Rodri, and Liverpool visiting Inter Milan, who have signed Curtis Jones.

Arsenal will also travel to Harry Kane’s Bayern Munich, while United will host the Germans as well on their Champions League return in a repeat of the legendary 1999 final. Michael Carrick’s side will also visit Cesc Fàbregas’s Como.

Mourinho last managed at the Emirates Stadium in March 2021, barely a month before his sacking by Spurs.

During his two spells as Chelsea manager, Mourinho famously had run-ins with Arsenal’s Arsène Wenger.

Mourinho called Wenger a “specialist in failure” after the Frenchman failed to add to his three Premier League titles following his Portuguese counterpart’s arrival in London in 2004.

Last season, Mikel Arteta finally ended Arsenal’s long wait to be crowned champions of England but agonisingly missed out on European glory.

Verdict Premier League champions should not be daunted by any game, but Real Madrid – with Mourinho in control – has the feel of a defining match of the group stage. Facing Kane in Munich does not seem any easier. Some tough assignments here including a trip to Napoli but the pot-four teams seem straightforward for Mikel Arteta.

Industry observers note that verdict Playing against the European champions and travelling to Barcelona will be a true test of how much progress Enzo Maresca has made in the short time he has been at the Etihad Stadium. City’s other games do not look easy either but they should be defeating teams such as Sporting Lisbon and Porto – at least they would be expected to under Pep Guardiola.

Verdict The San Siro was where Arne Slot began to turn results around last season and Iraola getting a win there would be a big statement. Atlético staged a comeback at Anfield in 2020 and the repeat fixture will be tight. But there are enough winnable games there for Liverpool to reach the next round.

Verdict They will face a wall of noise in Istanbul when they play Galatasaray, but Villa will look to get points from the game. There are some tasty destinations for travelling fans and getting results there will ease the pressure on the match against PSG, who have been rattled by Villa before but remain a difficult opponent. The Nou Camp is a place where momentum can change in a season – for good or bad.

Verdict The repeat of the 1999 final is the standout fixture, but Michael Carrick should be looking beyond that match for the points needed to progress. He has been given a tough set of away games to navigate. They are winnable but difficult. So those games at Old Trafford will be very key.

That brings our coverage of the Champions League draw to an end, as the 36 teams found which eight teams they will be facing in the league phase of this season’s tournament. Thanks for joining us!

The league phase will kick off on 8 September and will be wrapped up after all teams play at the same time on 27 January.

The top eight teams of the league phase progress to the last 16 automatically, while teams that finish between ninth and 24th will be forced to navigate a play-off tie to reach the knockout stages.

This season is the third under the latest format, with a league phase instead of a group stage, and Uefa has confirmed that fixtures that have taken place in the league phase of the two previous seasons cannot be repeated this time around.

It has been revealed that for example, Liverpool cannot host Real Madrid in the league phase this term after welcoming the 15-time European champions to Anfield at this stage of the previous two campaigns. Andoni Iraola’s side could, however, travel to the Bernabeu for an away meeting with Madrid.

Liverpool, meanwhile, topped the league phase in the 2024-25 campaign – the first season with the new format – but fell at the first hurdle in the knockout stages after being drawn against Paris St-Germain.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

According to recent reports, in casa Napoli c’è ottimismo dopo il buon risultato a Manchester, un pari che regala buone sensazioni in vista delle prossime gare. Uno dei migliori in questo periodo è Scott McTominay e ieri nel prepartita del match il Ds Giovanni Manna ha incontrato a Manchester l’agente del giocatore e si è parlato del rinnovo.

In a recent development, come riporta il Corriere dello Sport il club ha manifestato al giocatore l’intenzione di rinnovare il contratto, lo scozzese è fondamentale e anche in queste ultime gare ha dimostrato la sua importanza nella squadra di Allegri. Ma il procuratore del calciatore ha manifestato a Manna e alla società l’intenzione di veder riconosciuta quest’importanza.

According to recent reports, come riporta il Corriere dello Sport Scott McTominay vuole ben 10 milioni di euro all’anno, un ultimo grande contratto che lo determini come uomo chiave all’interno del club, fondamentale anche in chiave futura. Il Napoli vuole accontentare il giocatore, ma ovviamente bisognerà trovare un punto di incontro.

It has been revealed that gli addii di Anguissa e De Bruyne a fine stagione potrebbero facilitare, ma occorre trovare un’intesa e non sarà semplice. Il quotidiano parla di inverno piuttosto freddo e intenso nelle dinamiche del club partenopeo.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Scegli Fcinter1908.it come tuo sito preferito su Google: clicca qui.

According to recent reports, 11 gol in 11 partite per Gustavo Varela, una delle rivelazioni di questo campionato. Il portoghese classe 2005 si sta mettendo in mostra con la maglia del Monza e sarà sicuramente un uomo mercato già a gennaio.

Recent findings suggest that "Inter, Napoli e Juventus lo seguono, ma per trasformare l’interesse in un’operazione concreta serve un’accelerazione che al momento non c’è ancora stata. Il rischio è che, aspettando troppo, la concorrenza internazionale renda tutto più complicato. Varela sta vivendo una stagione straordinaria. Undici reti in undici partite rappresentano un impatto impressionante, soprattutto considerando il percorso con cui si sta affermando nel calcio italiano. Numeri che raccontano un giocatore capace di lasciare il segno con continuità e che inevitabilmente attirano l’attenzione delle società più ambiziose.

Il suo nome piace a diverse significant di Serie A. Inter, Napoli e Juventus sono attente alla sua crescita, ma al momento non si è ancora registrata un’accelerazione decisiva. È proprio questo il punto: Varela rappresenta un’occasione per tutto il calcio italiano e non soltanto per una singola società. Le dichiarazioni dei protagonisti del nostro campionato, comprese quelle di Beppe Marotta, confermano quanto il suo profilo sia apprezzato", scrive Gianluigi Longari su Sportitalia.

It has been revealed that "Il valore del giocatore ha già superato i 30 milioni di euro e potrebbe crescere ulteriormente se il Monza riuscisse a trattenerlo fino al termine della stagione. La società brianzola lo ha acquisito a titolo definitivo, consolidando una posizione importante in vista delle eventuali trattative future. Resta da considerare anche la posizione del Benfica, che secondo le informazioni circolate manterrebbe una tutela economica sull’operazione, attraverso una possibile prelazione o una percentuale sulla futura plusvalenza: un aspetto contrattuale da valutare con attenzione. Il paragone con Malen può aiutare a comprendere il tipo di impatto che un giocatore può avere quando trova l’ambiente giusto e riesce a esprimere tutto il proprio potenziale. E viene naturale tornare con la memoria anche a Diego Milito: non per stabilire equivalenze tecniche, ma per ricordare quanto il campionato italiano sappia valorizzare attaccanti capaci di incidere con continuità.

Le società italiane, però, devono essere consapevoli di un rischio: se continueranno a limitarsi a osservare, potrebbero lasciare spazio ai club della Premier League. Con la disponibilità economica di cui dispongono le società inglesi, una trattativa potrebbe diventare rapidamente fuori portata per le nostre big. Per questo Inter, Napoli e Juventus devono capire se Varela sia davvero un obiettivo e, in caso affermativo, muoversi per tempo", chiosa poi il giornalista.

Jude Bellingham and Real Madrid are advancing in talks over a new contract that will make him one of the best paid players in Europe.

Madrid have been eager to tie down the in-form England midfielder beyond his current contract, understood to be worth around £12.5million a year after tax, which runs until 2029, in recognition of his performances.

Talks were initiated in September over an extension until 2031 and have been progressing well since with sources at Madrid confident they are close to reaching a conclusion.

Bellingham is expected to be handed improved terms to put him on par with team-mate Vinicius Jr, who agreed a new deal last summer reputedly on around £500,000 a week after tax.

Sources indicate that kylian Mbappe remains the best paid player at the club while talks are also advancing over a latest contract for Fede Valverde. Real have also recently renewed the contracts of Turkish winger Arda Guler and France international Aurelien Tchouameni on deals until 2032.

Jude Bellingham and Real Madrid are advancing in talks over a contract extension until 2031.

The new deal at Madrid will make England's superstar one of the highest earners in Europe - on par with Vinicius Junior's £500,000-a-week contract (Pictured left at his unveiling in 2023).

The contract for Bellingham will be just reward for the 23-year-old who has flourished under coach Jose Mourinho who recently described the former Birmingham City academy graduate as ‘one of a kind’.

1. Erling Haaland, Manchester City: £510,000 per week.

Recent findings suggest that 2. Kylian Mbappe, Real Madrid: £503,000 per week.

3. Vinicius Jr, Real Madrid: £500,000 per week.

4. Harry Kane, Bayern Munich: £402,000 per week.

According to recent reports, 5. Virgil van Dijk, Liverpool: £350,000 per week.

Bellingham, who has scored six goals this season, could be rested for Madrid’s Champions League tie with PSV Eindhoven tonight but was still the topic of conversation as goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois praised his influence on the team on Monday.

‘Jude is someone who really wants to win,’ said Courtois. ‘That's why on the field he swears a lot! He's really a winner, and when he's not happy, he will make it known. He's also a leader on the field. He's a great player, a great mentality. You need those kind of people like that in your team that go for everything.

‘Jude is a young guy but when you see him, it feels like he's a few years older.

It has been revealed that ‘It seems like he has an engine to play 200 minutes. He keeps on going, running with the ball, it's really hard to dispossess him. And on the outside he just works hard, he goes to the gym. With a good Jude, we play better.’.

#221988. Cherki magic helping Maresca to step out of Guardiola shadow

Cherki magic helping Maresca to step out of Guardiola shadow

📅 28 Aug 2026 | ⏱️ 26 min read (5248 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~26 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Rumours of Manchester City’s supposed demise without Pep Guardiola appear to be much exaggerated.
  • Sources indicate that they swept past Crystal Palace at Selhurst Park with a style of play under new manager Enzo Maresca that was just as swashbuckling as under his predecessor, with Rayan Cherki playing the role of chief architect.
  • City created enough space for themselves through clever movement.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Rumours of Manchester City’s supposed demise without Pep Guardiola appear to be much exaggerated.

Sources indicate that they swept past Crystal Palace at Selhurst Park with a style of play under new manager Enzo Maresca that was just as swashbuckling as under his predecessor, with Rayan Cherki playing the role of chief architect. The Frenchman’s two goals included a captivating mazy dribble, which will long be remembered by those who had the fortune to see it.

City created enough space for themselves through clever movement. With Cherki zigging one way and Phil Foden zagging the other, they created even more by dribbling past a mesmerised Palace back three that became a back five at times and still could not cope.

Recent findings suggest that erling Haaland also scored twice. Even with the creative and unpredictable talents of those behind in a four-man attacking City midfield, Haaland remains irreplaceable with his ability to convert chances.

Recent findings suggest that however, this night belonged to Cherki. Guardiola chided him publicly after he set up a City goal with a “rabona” cross last season. The thrust of Guardiola’s comments were that Cherki was not Lionel Messi. Of course not, but he possesses a genius all of his own, which Maresca would surely be foolish to rein in.

The jaw-dropping splendour of Cherki’s first goal drew a collective intake of breath at Selhurst Park.

Collecting a Foden pass, he attacked the Palace area on a diagonal path, slaloming between Jaydee Canvot, Takehiro Tomiyasu and Chris Richards, before having the spatial awareness and technique to flick his left foot at the ball to send it rolling on a perpendicular trajectory past Dean Henderson.

"The man with the magic feet!"Rayan Cherki doubles Manchester City's lead with a STUNNING goal 😮‍💨 pic.twitter.com/9Zea5vFljv.

An insight into Cherki’s mindset came after the match.

It has been revealed that he remarked: “My performance is s---. In the first half, we didn’t find the space, I played bad. I need to show them that I want to play, I want to score. Next time I want to give the ball around more.”.

Forget the words, Maresca cannot ignore the actions of a player he left on the bench against Bournemouth.

Sterner tests will come for City than against a Palace side missing key players who may or may not leave south London in the remaining days of the transfer window.

Whether Maresca will trust his forward players to express themselves as freely against their rivals for the Premier League title remains to be seen, but with Elliot Anderson providing a one-man shield behind them, City could not be stopped.

Industry observers note that maresca mentioned: “For sure Rayan is happy tonight. His performance was very good and not just for his two goals. He has to press off the ball and he was in charge of [marking] Adam Wharton, so it was a complete game by him.”.

Only for the first three minutes did Palace hint at a different outcome but, after shots from Eddie Nketiah and Daichi Kamada were diverted away for corners, City took control.

They took the lead in the 17th minute when the otherwise quiet Antoine Semenyo flighted a cross over the heads of everyone except the shorn locks of Haaland, whose determined header looped over Henderson and dropped in the far corner.

The only negative of Foden’s performance came in front of goal, with a ballooned shot and a mistimed header.

After Cherki’s solo masterpiece had made it 2-0, Yeremy Pino seized the next moment for his own with a stunning free-kick that flicked the crossbar, then the back of City keeper Gianluigi Donnarumma before finally dropping over the line.

"This is a good a free-kick as you're likely to see this season!" Yéremy Pino's stirke beats Donnarumma 🎯 pic.twitter.com/5uF4vzOXDp.

Whatever hope that mustered was snatched away again when Cherki scored his second goal and the third goal of a breathless five minutes.

His shot at the end of a darting run flicked the ankle of Tomiyasu to send it just out of Henderson’s reach.

Recent findings suggest that rayan Cherki AGAIN! Manchester City have breathing room once again after another strike from the Frenchman 👏 pic.twitter.com/Tyw9whPS2r.

Morocco teenager Ayyoub Bouaddi had little time to show why City have paid Lille £85.6m for him with a late entry as a substitute, but they didn’t need him on this occasion.

Foden then set off on a swerving run that set up Haaland to lash home his second goal of the game and make it 4-1.

In a recent development, erling Haaland scores gets another! 🔥 pic.twitter.com/4mz2eF7wFF.

The fear for Palace is that they cannot keep selling their best players and expecting to replicate the success on the pitch that has brought them three trophies in the past 15 months.

Recent findings suggest that leicester City offer a shuddering example of that. From Premier League champions to League One in 10 seasons.

Pierre Sage, the newly introduced Palace manager, will welcome the certainty that the closure of the transfer window will bring, particularly over the futures of forwards Ismaïla Sarr and Jean-Philippe Mateta, as well as wing-back Daniel Muñoz.

The one player he cannot afford to lose is Wharton, who matched the City midfield on his own at times in the first half.

It has been revealed that sage stated: “I think the score is heavy. We stayed in the game for 65 minutes and created some chances. We know we are in for a tough season, but we have created a lot of opportunities in the first two games.

“I could speak about the transfer window, but I don’t want to find an excuse. We just have to be sure that in four days’ time, the team will be better than today.”.

Industry observers note that “It has been a short pre-season. Rayan [Cherki], five weeks ago was at the World Cup. Game by game, we will be back, just need a few games. We played well, it is a fresh manager but we have been playing together, with the addition of a few new players. We know what to do and have to trust the system.”.

Industry observers note that “We have to keep on playing together, find out where we are best and how to play. We have so many good players and we have to fit everyone in. He has to keep going because we know how good Phil is, it is about showing it week in week out. This is the right step forward for everyone. We have to build on this.”.

"I'm just trying to play my football" 💪Elliot Anderson is excited about the future at Manchester City after his summer transfer 🔥 pic.twitter.com/huGv4Li3GZ.

According to recent reports, "Say what you actually mean!" 🤣Erling Haaland takes over Rayan Cherki's post-match interview! pic.twitter.com/adW6IU8DzQ.

2 + 2 - Rayan Cherki is the third player to have a game with multiple goals and another game with multiple assists across a team's first two matches of a Premier League campaign, after Thierry Henry in 2004-05 and Didier Drogba in 2010-11.Polymath. pic.twitter.com/4cRV0xMIFa.

Pierre Sage’s side will host Middlesbrough in the League Cup third round next month and will also begin their Europa League campaign in September.

The directions of these teams will be diverging this season. City were wonderful, free-flowing, expressive and fun to watch. Palace not so much. It will take Pierre Sage a while to impose his style of play. It will certainly take another week before he knows his final squad for the first half of the season.

It was noticeable at the final whistle that many Palace fans stayed around to applaud Daniel Munoz, an unused substitute on the night, as he made his way to the tunnel, probably for the final time as a Palace player if Nottingham Forest’s interest in him becomes a transfer by the end of the window.

"Cherki was the difference" 🪄"He is a genius" 🧠Jamie Redknapp reacts to Crystal Palace 1-4 Man City 🔊 pic.twitter.com/UjSarMngDR.

Manchester City will take on Norwich in the League Cup third round in September and will also have their first Champions League match next month.

Pretty comprehensive in Manchester City’s favour, which is reflected in the scoreline.

The final whistle is blown at Selhurst Park and Manchester City have cruised to a 4-1 win thanks to doubles from Cherki and Haaland. Enzo Maresca’s side make it two wins from two whereas it is two defeats from two for Pierre Sage.

Manchester City, with the three points already in the bag, are just stroking the ball around with ease and are in complete control. Palace can barely get a foot on it.

There will be five added minutes.

A late double substitution for Manchester City as Reis and Braithwaite come on. Enzo Maresca’s side are cruising to victory to make it two wins from two.

Sources indicate that cherki has two goals to his name and now Haaland does as Manchester City are romping to victory in south London. Guehi wins possession for City inside the Palace half and the ball comes to Foden, who dribbles towards the Palace penalty area. He lays it off to his left to Haaland who, from a narrow angle, finds the root of the net.

Erling Haaland scores gets another! 🔥 pic.twitter.com/4mz2eF7wFF.

Nearly an instant impact from McAidoo as the 18-year-old drives through the Palace half and curls a shot from the edge of the box that goes just wide.

When Manchester City were making those substitutions, the Crystal Palace fans were making sure they let the officials know how long the Manchester City players were taking to get off.

Recent findings suggest that there is going to be a debut for the Premier League’s most expensive teenager ever as Bouaddi comes on for Manchester City. McAidoo is also coming on, with Cherki and Anderson going off.

Recent findings suggest that mingueza eventually comes on but not after having to wait until the ball goes out of play again as Khalaili was adjudged to have taken too long to have got off the pitch. Safe to say the Palace fans are not too impressed with that new rule. It will probably be a pub question in the years ahead. That change does mean that Palace have used all five substitutions, which means Munoz will not come on. He is being linked with a reunion with Oliver Glasner at Nottingham Forest in the final days of this window.

Crystal Palace make another double change and it will be two debuts as Disasi and Mingueza come on.

Enzo Maresca turns to his bench for the first time tonight as Kovacic comes on.

Khalaili brings down Semenyo and is booked for that challenge.

Palace are going to make a double substitution as McNeil and Gozo replace Nketiah and Pino. 19-year-old Gozo is on for his Palace debut.

According to recent reports, that was a chance for Palace. Guessand finds Pino, who drives into the Manchester City penalty area on the right. Pino has Nketiah at the far post but there is too much on the cross.

Guessand, back at Palace, is going to come on to replace Strand Larsen, who has been pretty quiet up top for the home side tonight.

Sometimes you feel blessed to witness an extraordinary moment of footballing genius. Selhurst Park has just seen two in the space of three minutes. Yeremy Pino’s free-kick which flicked off the back of Gianluigi Donnarumma was stunning, but even that could not truly compare to the slalom run of Rayan Cherki that drew a collective intake of breath from all those present. The Frenchman has just followed it with a scorching shot. It couldn’t compare with his first, though.

It has been revealed that three goals come in quick succession and Cherki restores Manchester City’s two-goal advantage with his second of the night. The Frenchman receives it on the turn from around 30 yards out and drives towards the Palace penalty area. He then shoots and a kind deflection off Richards takes it over Henderson’s diving effort and into the Palace net.

Recent findings suggest that rayan Cherki AGAIN! Manchester City have breathing room once again after another strike from the Frenchman 👏 pic.twitter.com/Tyw9whPS2r.

Sources indicate that just as the hosts appeared to maybe out of this one, they get a goal back. Pino’s fantastic free-kick strikes the bar, hits Donnarumma on the back before going into the net off the post. That hit the frame of the goal twice and Palace have a crucial goal, minutes after going 2-0 down.

"This is a good a free-kick as you're likely to see this season!" Yéremy Pino's stirke beats Donnarumma 🎯 pic.twitter.com/5uF4vzOXDp.

Anderson brings down Pino not far outside the Manchester City penalty area and is booked.

Pino is lining up the free-kick...

In a recent development, the next goal in this game felt crucial and the visitors have it. Foden drives towards the Palace penalty area before playing a pass forward into the path of Cherki. The Frenchman has numerous defenders around but he indicates neat footwork to skip past a few, holds off Richards before slotting home with his left foot.

"The man with the magic feet!"Rayan Cherki doubles Manchester City's lead with a STUNNING goal 😮‍💨 pic.twitter.com/9Zea5vFljv.

Industry observers note that no-one has had fewer touches on the pitch tonight than Haaland up until this point but the Norwegian’s goal is the difference. His number of touches (14) is the joint fewest with his compatriot Strand Larsen.

According to recent reports, that was a good chance for Nketiah. He plays the ball to the underlapping Mitchell, who from the byline cuts it back into the path of Nketiah. The former Arsenal man should so so much better with his opportunity from the edge of the six-yard box but fires a long way wide.

Semenyo wins Manchester City an early corner in this second half off Canvot. Anderson’s delivery beyond the back post picks out O’Reilly, who in space heads back across goal but Pino heads away.

We are back under way at Selhurst Park, with Manchester City carrying a 1-0 lead into this second half. As the players emerged from the tunnels for the second half, the DJ at Selhurst Park paid tribute to the late Dolly Parton and Kenny Rogers by playing Islands in the Stream. Nice touch! No changes for either side at the break.

The stats are certainly in Manchester City’s favour and they will feel they probably should have more than the one goal.

Cherki has a late chance for Manchester City but his shot is well saved by Henderson down to his right.

The first half at Selhurst Park is then brought to an end and Manchester City lead 1-0 at the break thanks to Haaland’s header.

There will be just one added minute at the end of this first half.

Palace started off with a nominal back three. That has become a back five far too often for Pierre Sage’s liking at times in this first half, yet still City are playing through them almost at will. The Palace fans whose deafening support accompanied Palace shots in the opening minutes are reduced to cheering battling midfield runs that win a free-kick now.

Pino delivers a free-kick into the Manchester City box and Richards gets to it first. It comes off his shoulder and rolls into the arms of Donnarumma.

Semenyo’s shot from the left side of the box takes a deflection off Richards, forcing Henderson into a decent save.

Palace now miss a significant opportunity and should be on level terms. Wharton, who has probably been the best player on the pitch tonight, whips in a cross from the right and picks out Mitchell, who has a free header from eight yards out but somehow misses the target.

Strand Larsen comes close with a header from a Pino cross but he would have been offside anyway.

According to recent reports, the first booking of the night goes the way of the visitors. Wharton drives forward into the Manchester City half and is cynically brought down by Cherki, who looked perplexed when the yellow card was shown but it was an obvious booking.

Recent findings suggest that foden wastes his second major chance of this first half. Manchester City break through O’Reilly, who carries it down the right. He waits for Cherki to make the overlapping run before passing to the Frenchman. Cherki’s cross picks out Foden inside the six-yard box and the latter should score but he gets a simple header all wrong.

According to recent reports, well, that was easy. So easy in fact – perfect Semenyo cross, perfect Haaland header - that it hushed Selhurst Park as the ball looped over Dean Henderson. Even the roar from the enclave of City fans took a moment to fill the south London air. You wouldn’t say that all the pre-match optimism among Palace fans has been punctured, but the home side need a moment if they aren’t to sink without trace to a City side bossing possession and territory now.

Sources indicate that that is a huge miss from Foden. Anderson picks out his compatriot in acres of space on the right side of the box, with no Palace defender within five yards of him, but Foden blazes over the bar when he should have put Manchester City 2-0 up.

King Harald V of Norway has died in the last few days and over the last few hours two Norwegian cyclists claimed a one-two at the Vuelta a Espana and now Haaland has a goal.

Industry observers note that he has barely touched the ball thus far but he puts the visitors ahead just past the quarter-of-an-hour mark. Semenyo is afforded too much space on the left just outside the penalty area and clips in a cross towards the far post. Haaland gets up highest, above Richards, and guides a superb header over Henderson into the Palace net.

Erling Haaland gets off the mark for the newly introduced Premier League season! ⚡️ pic.twitter.com/5ZjQUVk6Zl.

The England boss is in attendance tonight, perhaps keeping a close eye on that midfield battle between Anderson and Wharton.

According to recent reports, palace flirt with danger inside their own penalty area. After Haaland’s flick, Kamada should just belt the ball away but instead inexplicably leaves it. Henderson manages to mop up just as Foden was eyeing up the chance.

Recent findings suggest that there is a mad scramble inside the Palace box but somehow the hosts escape without conceding. Initially, Anderson’s shot from range is saved by Henderson but Manchester City keep it alive in the penalty area. Palace frantically attempt to clear their lines and eventually they do after Haaland came close.

Sources indicate that quite a lot of the focus tonight will be on two English midfielders; one who has got a significant-money move this summer and the other thus far has not. Anderson is directly up against Wharton and so far it is the latter who is winning the early battles, including dispossessing Anderson in midfield.

The first chance of the game goes the way of the hosts. It stems from a quite sensational first-time pass from Wharton from inside his own half into the left channel to pick out the run of Nketiah, whose shot from the left side of the box takes a deflection off Dias and is saved by Donnarumma.

Sources indicate that manchester City initially clear the corner but Palace keep it alive. Kamada’s shot from just inside the box appeared to be on target but it is headed over for another corner, which is easily caught by Donnarumma.

It has been revealed that we are under way at Selhurst Park. Will Pierre Sage earn his first win as Palace boss or can Enzo Maresca and City make it two wins from two?

Both sides emerge from the tunnel in the corner of Selhurst Park to the customary sound of Glad All Over and we are moments away from kick-off in south London. Here is a reminder of how the two sides line up this evening:.

Yes! It may have been fleeting but the boy in the Palace tracksuit top had his moment after all with Erling Haaland as City waited in line to enter the Selhurst Park pitch. And having done so, he fairly skipped up the steps back with his dad back to their seats. Whether the boy’s second wish of the evening, for a Palace victory, will come true is another question altogether.

It has been revealed that the young Palace fan is still waiting for Haaland. Another determined walk back to the dressing room. It isn’t a simple task to attract an opposition player’s attention when you are leaning over a barrier a few feet higher than him – and in the home end. Haaland and his teammates have the look of a team that knows it must perform tonight to ease the concerns that they are a team in transition. The City fans will not entertain such thoughts, either.

Industry observers note that crystal Palace looked set to sign Club Brugge defender Joel Ordonez but that deal could be in doubt as there may be some problems with his medical. We await to see further updates on that situation.

Recent findings suggest that “He is a genius. Make no mistake. Managers now want structure, they do not like players who are a bit loose out of possession. But I go to football matches to watch people like him play.

Sources indicate that “That is what makes me smile. I do not like watching players pass it sideways, that is not why I go to football. I go to watch geniuses do their work. Jack Grealish is not in the Manchester City squad tonight amid links with the likes of Everton and Sunderland. Will he still be at the club beyond the deadline? It would appear not.

Recent findings suggest that both Ismaila Sarr and Jean-Philippe Mateta are out of the Crystal Palace squad tonight with injury but could they be on the move before the window slams shut? Industry observers note that was it really just a year ago when Crystal Palace fans flooded down the Holmesdale Road with not a care in the world having just won the Community Shield to add to their FA Cup triumph over tonight’s opponents Manchester City? Well, they are marching along the Holmesdale Road in the same numbers again this evening, bedecked in red and blue as always, yet there is uncertainty and worry in the air and on their faces. Will the player exodus continue? What should they make of upcoming manager Pierre Sage? Will the good times fade from view as swiftly as they did for Leicester City or can Sage build a new side to match the one which, under Oliver Glasner, added the Conference League to their list of trophies three months ago?

“We struggled to get into the game and win the battles,” a disappointed Carlo Ancelotti lamented.

According to recent reports, at the World Cup, an industrious 18-year-old showed maturity beyond his years to dominate the midfield against Ancelotti’s Brazil on his competitive international debut, earning Morocco a draw. That was, in fact, the second time an Ancelotti side had been undone by precocious teenager Ayyoub Bouaddi.

Industry observers note that ancelotti’s remarks about losing the midfield battle are from after a Champions League match in October 2024, when Lille shocked Real Madrid to end their 36-game unbeaten run. Bouaddi was at the heart of both statement results for his club and country.

Recent findings suggest that the second weekend of the Premier League season kicks off under the lights in South London as Crystal Palace host Manchester City at Selhurst Park. Manchester City won both fixtures 3-0 last season and they are in fact unbeaten in their last 11 Premier league away games against Crystal Palace, who have won just two of the 22 top flight meetings.

Crystal Palace experienced defeat on the opening weekend, falling to a 2-0 loss at Everton last Saturday, meaning the Pierre Sage era started with a defeat. Tonight is Sage’s first home game in charge of the club.

“I think it will be a wonderful moment, but I prefer to have a wonderful moment with good news at the end of the game,” Sage mentioned. “That is why I do not think about me in this situation. The most important thing is the team and the result for sure, because we prepare all the week for that, to make them [the fans] happy. They will be happy to see us, but I think they would prefer to see us win. I will give my life to make them happy. I cannot do more. When you are in this stadium [Selhurst Park], you feel the history. You feel that there is something heavy weighing on you. It is a great responsibility that I have been entrusted with. We cannot wait to see this stadium in action.”.

In a recent development, sage has confirmed that Ismaila Sarr, who has been linked with a move away from the club this summer, and Chadi Riad will miss out tonight due to injury, as will striker Jean-Philippe Mateta. Palace have confirmed the addition of Axel Disasi on loan from Chelsea and the French defender could be involved tonight.

Recent findings suggest that manchester City appeared to be heading towards defeat in Enzo Maresca’s first league game in charge of the club last weekend. They were 1-0 down at home against Bournemouth in the closing stages before goals from Marc Guehi and Josko Gvardiol gave them a come-from-behind win.

It has been a busy week in the transfer window for Manchester City. Both Savio (formerly Savinho) and Omar Marmoush have left for Tottenham, joining a long list of departures from the Etihad this summer. Moroccan midfielder Ayyoub Bouaddi has arrived in an £85m deal from Lille and has become the most expensive teenager in Premier League history. Maresca has confirmed that 18-year-old Bouaddi is ready to start.

It has been revealed that “He [Bouaddi] is ready,” Maresca said. “He was working with his former club so he is fit. We will see how long he needs in terms of adaptation but he is ready to go. He is quite calm. He does not look 18, he already looks older, which is important. But in this case, we need to go slowly because he is very young, he has come from a different country so there is no rush for him. He is going to help us now and in the future. He is very mature for being 18.”.

Team news from Selhurst Park to follow shortly.

In a recent development, "Anche il Barcellona guarda al mercato dei difensori e valuta profili di alto livello per rinforzare il reparto. Tra i nomi da tenere in considerazione c’è Alessandro Bastoni, un giocatore che per qualità, personalità e capacità di impostare l’azione sarebbe particolarmente adatto al calcio di Hansi Flick. Il grande sogno per l’estate sarebbe invece Josko Gvardiol del Manchester City. Un’operazione estremamente complicata, sia per i costi sia per l’importanza del croato nella squadra inglese, ma che rappresenterebbe un investimento di primissimo livello per il Barcellona. Da mantenere viva anche la pista Nijstad, classe 2008 del Twente. Un talento giovanissimo che merita di essere seguito con attenzione, soprattutto in ottica futura. Le ultime dai campi e le probabili formazioni di Venezia-Bologna:.

In a recent development, si rinnova il ballottaggio fra Lauberbach e Yeboah in attacco, per affiancare Adams che dovrebbe essere confermato come riferimento offensivo. A proposito dell'attacco: torna Adorante in panchina, che freme per dire la sua per la prima volta in Serie A, con Duncan tolto dalla lista per fargli spazio. Recuperati Basic e Mazzocchi, entrambi da valutare se già dal primo minuto, altrimenti sono pronti Busio e Haps. A completare la mediana Kike Perez e Sohm, sulla fascia sinistra ancora Hainaut, fresco di rinnovo fino al 2030. Davanti a Stankovic scalpita Bella-Kotchap, ma Moreno è ancora favorito per guidare la difesa con Halhal e Juan Jesus ai suoi lati. (da Venezia, Daniele Najjar).

Sources indicate that se generalmente Raffaele Palladino ci aveva abituati al più classico dei “squadra che vince non si cambia”, questa volta - per stessa ammissione del tecnico campano - la formazione del Bologna è un vero e proprio “rebus”. In vista della trasferta di Venezia, Palladino dovrà sciogliere un mare, anzi una laguna, di dubbi. In porta la certezza sarà Skorupski. In difesa - salvo sorprese - confermato il tridente composto da Darmian (in vantaggio su Vitik), Casale e Theate. In mediana inamovibili Ferguson e Pobega. Sugli esterni di centrocampo agiranno Zortea e Alhassane. Il difficile arriva davanti, dove tutti gli esterni offensivi e tre centravanti su quattro sono a completa disposizione. Odgaard dopo cinque partite da titolare potrebbe lasciare il posto a Piccoli che manca dal 17 ottobre dopo l'infortunio patito al Dall'Ara nella gara contro l'Inter. Alle sue spalle, dato per scontato che sia impensabile tenere fuori un Cambiaghi in formato Nazionale, l’altra maglia se la contenderanno Bernardeschi ed Orsolini, con quest’ultimo - uscito all’intervallo nella gara com l’Udinese - di poco avanti nel ballottaggio. (da Venezia, Leonardo Nevischi).

Il gruppo HBHC sostiene di aver tentato senza successo di estorcere denaro all’organizzazione calcistica.

Sources indicate that la Fifa ha confermato la sottrazione di dati interni durante un recente attacco informatico. Secondo quanto riportato da SportMediaset, Il gruppo di criminalità informatica Handsome Boy Hacking Club sostiene di aver prelevato oltre 12 GB di dati e di aver tentato, senza successo, di estorcere denaro all’organizzazione.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

La conferma è riportata dal sito specializzato in cybersecurity The Record, citato da SportMediaset. L’organizzazione calcistica, che ha sede in Svizzera, ha dichiarato che gli hacker hanno violato i suoi sistemi, ottenendo un «accesso non autorizzato a un insieme limitato di informazioni personali e aziendali».

Un portavoce ha affermato: «La Fifa sta collaborando strettamente con le autorità competenti, incluse le forze dell'ordine». La Fifa «condanna con la massima fermezza l'acquisizione e la pubblicazione illecite di informazioni, in particolare di dati personali. Tali azioni costituiscono una violazione grave e inaccettabile della privacy e possono avere conseguenze significative per le persone coinvolte».

L’organizzazione non ha risposto a ulteriori domande sulla natura dell’incidente. La scorsa settimana, il gruppo Handsome Boy Hacking Club (HBHC) ha dichiarato di aver sottratto oltre 12 GB di dati alla Fifa. Il gruppo ha anche riferito di aver tentato senza successo di estorcerle denaro.

Tra le informazioni sottratte figurerebbero documenti d’identità e relativi all’immigrazione, documentazione finanziaria e legale, informazioni sulla governance e altri dati.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Published: 03:43 EST, 24 November 2026 | Updated: 03:45 EST, 24 November 2026.
  • Merseyside Police reportedly arrested seven supporters at last weekend's clash between Manchester United and Liverpool, with two on suspicion of tragedy chanting.
  • The bitter rivals met at Anfield for the first time in the Premier League season as Mauricio Pochettino kicked off his stint as Man United manager - under the most concerning circumstances.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By TAMARA PRENN, SENIOR SPORTS REPORTER.

Published: 03:43 EST, 24 November 2026 | Updated: 03:45 EST, 24 November 2026.

Merseyside Police reportedly arrested seven supporters at last weekend's clash between Manchester United and Liverpool, with two on suspicion of tragedy chanting.

The bitter rivals met at Anfield for the first time in the Premier League season as Mauricio Pochettino kicked off his stint as Man United manager - under the most concerning circumstances.

But even before the visitors saw Leny Yoro sent off and four conceded without reply, this fixture has long been one of the most incendiary in the top flight.

Supporters arrested for suspected tragedy chanting are thought to be a 63-year-old man from Heywood, Greater Manchester, and a 57-year-old man from Wallasey, in Wirral, as per the Athletic.

Both clubs have waged independent battles against tragedy chanting, which sees fans taunt opponents by mocking major disasters, such as Hillsborough, the Heysel Stadium disaster, and the Munich air disaster.

Some tragedy chants are even aimed at the personal lives of players on the pitch, and in 2024, new guidance from the Crown Prosecution saw tragedy chanting upgraded to a criminal offence.

Seven people have been arrested following Man United's trip to face Liverpool at Anfield (police pictured breaking up a fight in the away end).

As well as tragedy chanting, a 47-year-old man from Swinton, Greater Manchester, was arrested on suspicion of possession of a class A drug.

Two men - a 49-year-old from Didsbury, South Manchester, and a 38-year-old from Denton, Greater Manchester - were arrested on suspicion of indecent and racialist chanting.

A further two, aged 30 and 23, were arrested during the final minutes of Sunday's clash as a skirmish broke out among the away supporters at Anfield.

But despite the enmity between the two teams, there were a greater number of arrests last month, when Man City visited Anfield for the first match in the wake of the revelation that the club had been found guilty of the vast majority of charges levelled at them for breaching the Premier League's financial regulations between 2009 and 2018.

That fixture saw 10 fans arrested, with five arrested on suspicion of tragedy chanting.

The match-up between the two sides became increasingly charged with the establishment of a rivalry at the top of the table under former managers Jurgen Klopp and Pep Guardiola.

In 2018, the Man City bus was attacked with bottles, bricks and flares ahead of a Champions League meeting between the two sides, with future fixtures in Liverpool at times seeing the players' bus route amended to avoid throngs of home fans.

In March 2025, Merseyside police requested an unorthodox kick-off of 3.45pm for the match, rather than the customary Sunday start time of 4.30pm, in a bid to reduce problems between the two sets of fans.

Andoni Iraola wanted to talk about his team and their need to improve but how could he concentrate on something so straightforward when he had seen something so bizarre?

It is important, first and foremost, to explain this is not painting a narrative about Liverpool being unfortunate. Far from it. Iraola hissed his dismay that Nottingham Forest had shown more intensity and been the better team for long periods in an entertaining 2-2 draw.

Sources indicate that but the penalty that changed the contest? Iraola, his coaching staff, even the supporters behind the dugout had been left flabbergasted that the malfunctioning number board of fourth official Tim Robinson presented an avenue for Forest to exploit.

Iraola had tried to make a triple change, wanting to introduce Ryan Gravenberch, Kostas Tsimikas and Rio Ngumoha, but as Robinson pressed buttons to no avail and everyone in Red became frustrated, Forest substitute Liam Delap took a quick throw and the Liverpool house almost caved in.

In a recent development, neco Williams, once of Liverpool, surged into the penalty area, Alisson Becker arrived a fraction too late after the defender got his shot away and took his old team-mate down. Morgan Gibbs-White exacerbated the damage when sending Alisson the wrong way and this was the last thing a manager wanting to make an impression on a big day needed to see but this was reality.

Sources indicate that alisson takes out Neco Williams and Forest have a penalty! 😱📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/fX2flY3Tob.

Sources indicate that gibbs-White converts from the spot to restore Forest's lead! 🌳🎯📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/jeoPiXPArw.

“I cannot explain because I don’t have an explanation,” Iraola remarked. “I wanted to make those substitutions about three minutes before. I mean, it was two, three, four times the ball had gone out. I still don’t know the reason why we couldn’t make the subs.

Sources indicate that “I think [the fourth official] was having some problems with the board or something. It [the penalty] wouldn’t have happened if I had made the sub. I asked. I had complained the previous time. The supporters were shouting and they were aware of the situation. But I don’t know what happened and I don’t know why they have given the penalty.”.

"A professional fourth official cannot take three minutes." 😳Andoni Iraola was not happy with the time taken to get the substitutes' board ready.🎙️ @jules_breach | 📺 TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/fMfYOjQJPd.

Sources indicate that he did know, though, why Liverpool had needed to drag themselves off the deck again for the second week in a row. Iraola has shown in his opening weeks on Merseyside that he is not someone who seeks excuses.

“A lack of intensity hurt us,” Iraola said with obvious disdain and it was only down to a show of character in the second period that a slovenly first half did not enable Forest to win at Anfield for the third consecutive year, for all that the travelling fans thought it was “happening again!”.

Forest, bruised after two defeats in four days to Leeds, looked like an Oliver Glasner side. They were aggressive and well organised, the only failing was that physically they could not see the job through, but the Austrian insisted that will change in due course.

Once Glasner is settled in and he gets his transfer business done – “definitely one, possibly two and probably three,” was his mischievous reply to how the window will unfold – Forest will be a formidable proposition, especially if the first 45 minutes are a barometer.

It has been revealed that they had been knocking on the door before Dan Ndoye eventually broke the deadlock, sweeping a left-footed drive past Alisson after Igor Jesus had won a header from a long clearance. It was a simple goal, marginally onside, but it was absolutely deserved.

According to recent reports, on the development, Bhatia told Liverpool’s website: “It feels incredible. It feels surreal when I hear those words, obviously an incredibly proud moment for myself, for my family, for our partners. We’re talking about Liverpool Football Club here, right? I mean, we’re talking about the greatest football club in the world. And so to have the ability to be involved in any capacity is a huge privilege and a huge honour.”.

Having been linked to both Tottenham Hotspur and Manchester City, Cody Gakpo’s Liverpool future has looked doubtful at points this summer.

However, Spurs’ signings of Savinho and Omar Marmoush, as well as Manchester City’s potentially big-money pursuit of Enzo Fernandez, means that any exit for the Dutchman looks extremely complicated.

Gakpo scored Liverpool’s first equaliser in their chaotic 2-2 draw with Newcastle United and starts today on the left wing.

In September 2024, Nottingham Forest claimed their first win over Liverpool at Anfield in 55 years thanks to Callum Hudson-Odoi’s sumptuous 72nd-minute curler.

When Callum Hudson-Odoi made history at Anfield 🤩 pic.twitter.com/HhJ73WztMd.

Last season’s emphatic 3-0 victory in the same fixture under Sean Dyche means that Forest have successive wins at a ground where they could notoriously never manage three points.

Nottingham Forest have smashed their club-record transfer fee to sign Chelsea striker Liam Delap for £50m on a five-year deal, ending a lengthy pursuit by both the club and their head coach Oliver Glasner.

Last summer Delap held talks with Forest and Glasner, while he was in charge at Crystal Palace, before he opted to join his mentor and former Manchester City Under-21 coach Enzo Maresca at Stamford Bridge.

One of the summer’s most talked about and protracted transfer pursuits is nearing its conclusion as Liverpool have agreed a £120m deal with Paris St-Germain to sign Bradley Barcola.

The Frenchman was absent from PSG’s squad on Friday evening as Luis Enrique’s side drew 2-2 with Lille in Ligue 1.

Barcola is yet another big-money addition to Liverpool’s forward line, following on from the signings of Alexander Isak, Florian Wirtz and Hugo Ekitike last summer.

He also has the approval of club legend Steven Gerrard, who is at Anfield on duty for TNT Sports.

Good morning and welcome to our live coverage of this Premier League match between Liverpool and Nottingham Forest at Anfield.

This encounter pits two summer appointments – Andoni Iraola and Oliver Glasner – against each other as they both search for their first top-flight win at their fresh clubs.

Recent findings suggest that in the opening Premier League game-week, Iraola’s Liverpool needed a last-gasp 99th-minute penalty from Dominik Szoboszlai to rescue an unconvincing 2-2 draw with Newcastle United at St. James’ Park. Meanwhile, Nottingham Forest have suffered back-to-back home defeats in four days against Leeds United without scoring (1-0 Premier League, 2-0 Carabao Cup).

Iraola has been handed the unenviable task of steering Liverpool back on track following a hugely disappointing campaign under Arne Slot, whose side’s defence of their Premier League ended in a meek fifth-place finish despite spending more than £400m in the previous summer.

The former Bournemouth boss must uncover how to get the best out of big-money recruits such as Alexander Isak, Florian Wirtz, Milos Kerkez and Jeremie Frimpong, and also tighten up Liverpool’s vulnerable midfield and defence. Given the pressure of the job and the club’s hectic schedule while balancing domestic and European football, it’s a tough ask. However, Liverpool have agreed a £120m deal for Paris St-Germain winger Bradley Barcola to bolster their attacking reinforcements, but the transfer hasn’t been finalised in time for today’s match.

Recent findings suggest that last season, Forest endured an equally tumultuous campaign, churning through a staggering four managers, before eventually stumbling to a 16th-place finish. Glasner has been hand-picked by owner Evangelos Marinakis to usher in an era of stability and success, after winning the FA Cup, Community Shield and Conference League in just over two years at Crystal Palace.

Sources indicate that both Marinakis and Glasner are extremely ambitious and demanding figures. You’d imagine a top-half finish would be considered the absolute minimum for Forest, while Glasner’s track record of winning trophies surely indicates that Marinakis is eyeing some silverware at the City Ground.

It’s a meeting of two managers who must deliver. Three points for either side would serve as a much-needed tonic to kickstart their seasons.

Kick-off is at 12:30, with team news coming shortly.

Le ultime dai campi e le probabili formazioni di Frosinone-Parma:.

According to recent reports, alla vigilia della sfida contro il Parma allo stadio Benito Stirpe, in casa Frosinone restano pochissimi dubbi sulle scelte di formazione di mister Massimiliano Alvini. Il nodo principale riguarda l'assetto tattico da opporre ai ducali. Il tecnico canarino sembra intenzionato a tornare al 4-2-3-1 dove in difesa tornerebbe Gabriele Bracaglia, dopo il turno di squalifica scontato contro il Milan. Linea di difesa completata da Oyono, e al centro due tra Calvani, Monterisi e Cittadini. In mediana spazio a Calò e Masini, attualmente in vantaggio nel ballottaggio su Cichella. Sulla trequarti pronti Ghedjemis, Schmid e Kvernadze alle spalle di Tomas Bobcek, atteso alla sua prima presenza dal primo minuto. Se invece Alvini decidesse di tenersi lo slovacco come carta da giocare a gara in corso sarebbe nuovamente 3-4-3 come a San Siro con Schmid falso nove e a centrocampo uno tra Bracaglia e Tchato sulla corsia di sinistra. (da Frosinone, Stefano Martini).

Recent findings suggest that L’emergenza in difesa viene risolta dai ritorni di Diego Carlos e Ndiaye, con quest’ultimo pronto a riprendersi il posto da titolare come braccetto sinistro. Confermati Troilo al centro e Delprato alla sua destra, a completare il terzetto a difesa della porta di Daffara. In cabina di regia Sierro viene insidiato dal rientro di Nicolussi Caviglia, ma per una partita così delicata Gilardino si affiderà alle sue certezze. Proprio per questo Keita è sicuro del posto, mentre la titolarità di Fabbian scricchiola al cospetto di Bernabé, pronto a riprendersi una maglia dal primo minuto. Sulle corsie esterne il punto fermo è Valeri a sinistra, mentre a destra spazio al ballottaggio tra Britschgi e Cremaschi. In attacco Gilardino si affiderà ancora alla fisicità di Elphege, ma rimane aperto il dubbio tra Lontani e Touré, con quest’ultimo che finora è stato sempre (o quasi) preferito. (da Parma, Edoardo Mammoli).

According to recent reports, francesco Letizia, giornalista, si è così espresso sul suo canale Youtube commentando la vittoria del Milan contro l'Olympiacos: "Cosa ci lascia Olympiacos-Milan? Secondo me ci lascia innanzitutto una bella onda lunga di felicità e di entusiasmo, che serve perché, ve l'ho detto in sede di presentazione della gara, vincere aiuta a vincere e sicuramente perdere non ci avrebbe aiutato a vincere, e parlo di Cagliari e parlo del resto, perché questa squadra non è sufficientemente matura, scafata, esperta, abituata a determinati palcoscenici da riuscire a scindere i piani e le competizioni. E alla lunga continuare a prendere sottogamba l'Europa League, continuare a snobbare l'altra competizione ci avrebbe portato dei danni anche in campionato, quindi l'equazione «sì, ma l'Europa League è un'altra cosa» non funziona, secondo me. Può funzionare una partita, due, ma sul lungo periodo fare male in Europa League ci avrebbe danneggiato poi anche in campionato".

It has been revealed that letizia è entrato poi nelle pieghe del match: "Prima ancora di guardare la classifica, prima ancora di riflettere se passeremo o meno, in che modo passeremo, l'onda lunga è la spinta che ci arriva dalla partita di Atene, soprattutto per i modi. Perché noi nel primo tempo non ci abbiamo capito nulla, nulla, letteralmente nulla. Il 2-0 per l'Olympiacos è meritatissimo, una partita che poteva essere anche 3-0, una partita in cui noi non abbiamo mai visto il pallone e non abbiamo praticamente mai calciato in porta: mi ricordo solamente il salvataggio di Pirola praticamente sulla linea su un tentativo di Cisse, ma poi è successo veramente poco altro per non dire nulla. Ed è una partita che noi avevamo l'impressione ci stesse sfuggendo via esattamente come tutte le altre, perché la sensazione, il copione, l'opinione diffusa era Olympiacos-Milan come Milan-Benfica, come Milan-Ferencvaros, come Bournemouth-Milan, peggio di Bournemouth-Milan, perché secondo me stasera rispetto alle altre avevamo la formazione migliore in campo e soprattutto dovevamo avere ben presente, ben cosciente l'urgenza di fare una partita giusta, mentre invece magari nelle altre partite l'avevamo presa un po' sottogamba, avevamo pensato che non ci fosse tutta questa necessità di fare bene in Europa League e invece forse stavolta ce ne siamo accorti davvero".

In a recent development, intervistato dal De Telegraaf, Frank De Boer, insieme al fratello Ronald, ha affrontato diversi temi. Il tecnico è tornato soprattutto sulle sue fallimentari esperienza all'estero sottolineando quanto sia importante conoscere la lingua del Paese dove si va ad allenare. De Boer prende come esempio la sua esperienza sulla panchina dell'Inter. "Come dicevo prima, hai meno tempo a disposizione. All'inizio, sotto questo aspetto, sei anche un principiante: vai in un club straniero, non conosci la lingua e solo allora ti rendi conto di quanto sia importante la lingua per il tuo lavoro di allenatore".

Recent findings suggest that "Perché se io dico qualcosa e tu devi tradurlo ai giocatori, non so se tu stia dicendo esattamente le stesse cose che dico io, ma soprattutto c'è l'emozione... È davvero terribilmente complicato, perché ho vissuto la stessa esperienza in Italia, all'Inter. A un certo punto, Michel Kreek era praticamente il mio interprete, perché aveva giocato in Italia e parlava italiano, anche se non così bene, ma comunque traduceva per me. Eppure, anche in quel caso, il messaggio arriva in modo diverso".

"Allora ti chiedi: «Ma sta dicendo davvero quello che intendo io?». È una cosa davvero difficile quando fai l'allenatore. Vuoi conquistare quel gruppo, portarlo dalla tua parte. (1:14) E questo, in un certo senso, rappresenta un rallentamento per te e per lo sviluppo della tua squadra".

Al suo posto nel centrocampo a tre insieme a Frattesi e Belahyane ci sarà Dele-Bashiru, alla prima presenza da titolare in Serie A quest’anno. Novità anche in difesa rispetto alla sfida contro il Lecce, con il ritorno dal primo minuto di Oliver Provstgaard annunciato da Gattuso in conferenza stampa. Al fianco del danese Doekhi è in vantaggio nel ballottaggio con Diogo Leite, mentre Floriani Mussolini a destra e Pedraza a sinistra sono sicuri della titolarità così come Mandas tra i pali. In attacco Gattuso ritrova capitan Zaccagni, che torna a sinistra con l’accentramento di Noslin e il solito Isaksen sulla destra. (da Roma, Lorenzo Beccarisi).

  • A riportare l'attenzione sull'esultanza di Diego Moreira nel post gara è stata una domanda rivolta da un collega della stampa greca a Ruben Amorim in conferenza stampa: il tecnico rossonero a quel punto ha sentito il bisogno di scusarsi con il pubblico e club greco, gesto comunque onorevole e da sottolineare da parte sua, ma allo stesso tempo ha giustamente difeso l'intento del suo calciatore che non era certo così grave come sta venendo dipinto in queste ore.

Ieri sera il Milan ha completato la rimonta con un contropiede orchestrato dal solito Hutchinson, rifinito da Pulisic e finalizzato da Moreira. Primo gol europeo per Diego con la maglia rossonera e punteggio fissato sul 2-4. Nella sua esultanza Diego Moreira è andato a "sfidare" la caldissima curva dell'Olympiacos guardandola con sguardo fisso e serio, prima di mimare il gesto del "toc toc" e con un calcio sfondare la porta immaginaria. Un'esultanza che non è piaciuta ad alcuni giocatori della squadra greca (e ai tifosi), che si sono scagliati contro il giocatore milanista, e che negli strascichi post-gara sta generando un po' di polemiche francamente esagerate.

A riportare l'attenzione sull'esultanza di Diego Moreira nel post gara è stata una domanda rivolta da un collega della stampa greca a Ruben Amorim in conferenza stampa: il tecnico rossonero a quel punto ha sentito il bisogno di scusarsi con il pubblico e club greco, gesto comunque onorevole e da sottolineare da parte sua, ma allo stesso tempo ha giustamente difeso l'intento del suo calciatore che non era certo così grave come sta venendo dipinto in queste ore. Queste le parole di Amorim: "Non succederà più. Moreira è un ragazzo che vive come gioca, ma deve crescere. Sappiamo che non ci piacerebbe se lo facessero con i nostri tifosi. È una mia responsabilità, ma non l'ha fatto in maniera cattiva. Chiedo scusa, ma non l'ha fatto in maniera cattiva".

Diciamocelo chiaramente. Sicuramente, come ha sottolineato Ruben Amorim, Diego Moreira poteva magari evitare un'esultanza un po' provocatoria, ma allo stesso tempo non è sembrato essere un modo di festeggiare tanto più esuberante di molti che si sono visti sui campi da calcio nella storia di questo sport. Comprensibile, al termine di una gara così, il nervosismo dei giocatori greci, per carità: ma il campo ha offerto talmente tanti spunti e talmente tanto spettacolo da un lato e dall'altro, che ridursi a parlare solamente dell'esultanza di Moreira sul quarto gol pare una forzatura. Dal canto suo Diego Moreira, che fino a questo momento ha comunque avuto un atteggiamento sempre mai sopra le righe, può fare tesoro di questa esperienza come suggerito da Amorim, anche per evitare conseguenze spiacevoli: è un ragazzo intelligente e sicuramente lo avrà capito. Per il resto, per il clima caldo che c'è stato per tutti i 90 minuti, questo è un tema che poteva rimanere tranquillamente una "cosa di campo". Nient'altro da aggiungere.

In his 593rd game as Toffees boss, Moyes broke Harry Catterick’s 75-year record for most games in the dugout.

But that was about the only positive he could take away from the Gtech Community Stadium, as high-flying Brentford battered ten-man Everton on an evening to forget for the 63-year-old Scotsman.

Daily Mail Sport's Bobby Manzi was at the Gtech Community Stadium on a torrid night for the Toffees...

The Bees can mix it with big boys.

Brentford, having missed out on European football on goal difference last season, are showing all the signs of being there or thereabouts again.

They climbed to sixth, leapfrogging Leeds — who have had far more praise lavished on them this season than Keith Andrews’ reliable side.

Brentford are disciplined with plenty of attacking flair, even with frontman and top goalscorer Igor Thiago suspended.

This well-oiled Andrews machine must take advantage of the floundering elite, with Manchester United, Chelsea and Tottenham all struggling, and finally secure Europe.

‘We set out this season looking to be better than last season, and if that happens, we will be flying to different destinations next season,’ Andrews stated of their European hopes.’.

According to recent reports, ‘We've got a very competitive squad that strives to get better. If we continue with that mindset, we'll hopefully be in a good place.

It was a surprise to see Kevin Schade benched but this team is so cohesive, with more focus on the unit than any individual stars, that victory was light work for them.

James Tarkowski endured a depressing return to his former club when he was shown the first Premier League red card of his career.

Tarkowski blocked an initial effort from Lewis-Potter for the second goal but the ball fell straight back to him, and Jake O’Brien helped his second attempt past Jordan Pickford. Once again, Everton should have done better and cleared the initial free-kick.
